predecessors.name: Sasanian Empire
predecessors.text: Balasagan as a Sasanian province or vassal kingdom: 'first attested as a Sasanian province' in Shapur I's inscription (r.

successors.name: Rashidun Caliphate
successors.text: Balasagan after the Arab conquest: 'conquered in c.

ledger.x: 638: Cliopatria's Balasagan row begins on the Kura-Aras lowland by the Caspian.

c. 645: Salman ibn Rabi'a conquers Balasagan for the Arabs. 'Balasagan was conquered in c. 645 by an Arab army led by Salman ibn Rabi'a'; Cliopatria's row ends in 646. The page's 'c.' makes the year approximate.

wars.name: Arab conquest of Balasagan
wars.outcome: Arab victory: 'Balasagan was conquered in c.

certainty.note: The page places Balasagan only as the region 'in the area of the Kura and Aras rivers, adjacent to the Caspian Sea'; nothing dated draws a boundary.
